title: the thousandth temple
summary: A two-and-a-half-minute video podcast about Candi Prambanan: two cartoon hosts drawn in code, real photos on the big screen, and the legend of Roro Jonggrang told as a shadow play.
medium: animated video podcast, canvas 2d + web audio, six photographs, recorded voices

specs.length: about two and a half minutes, then it loops
specs.controls: click for sound, then click or space to pause, ← → skip 5 s, m mutes, v voices on / off
specs.drawn in code: the hosts, the studio, the ground plan, the encyclopedia page, the shadow play, the map, the captions
specs.photographs: six, from Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA), credited on screen and in the notes
specs.voices: ElevenLabs, one clip per line, with word timings that drive the captions and the mouths
specs.music: a small gamelan in a pelog tuning, made in the page
specs.inspired by: the Egyptian pyramids podcast by @kevin_t_ngo, posted by @claudeai on X (the format only; hosts, script and drawings are new)
